subject: Proposal: Acme - Path to Azure Marketplace Billing with Renewal Incentives
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: exploring marketplace billing for next renewal

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the quick chat this morning. As mentioned, the execs want us on Azure Marketplace for procurement reasons, but they need clarity on how the numbers will look on renewal (we're coming up on our Feb 2027 renewal). Two asks: 1) can Redwood provide an incentive/credit to offset the initial marketplace invoicing delta? and 2) Procurement needs a clear MAP (mutual action plan) and a short doc we can hand to legal.

Samir
Procurement Lead, Acme Commerce

---
Attachment: initial-cost-snapshot.csv (referenced by Samir)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, John Liu <john.liu@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: exploring marketplace billing for next renewal

Samir — thanks for the clear asks. I've sketched a pragmatic path that balances procurement requirements with predictable economics for Acme:

- Incentive proposal: Redwood offers a one-time marketplace credit equal to 25% of the expected three-month token spend after migration (applied as a contra-invoice) to neutralize the first billing cycle delta.
- Dual-invoice pilot: We can run a two-invoice overlap for 30 days so your finance team can reconcile differences before final cutover.
- MAP: I'll attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and a one-page legal checklist you can hand to counsel.

I've attached a draft 'marketplace-credit-proposal.pdf' and a MAP workbook. Ben can cover the pricing mechanics and I'll loop John from Azure to confirm any marketplace credits/process from the marketplace side.

Next step: Samir — can you share the procurement contact for legal? If procurement wants a redline-able SOW amendment, we can produce that within 48 hours of receiving a contact.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0164

Attachments: marketplace-credit-proposal.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, John Liu <john.liu@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: exploring marketplace billing for next renewal

Samir — quick note on mechanics. Two items to call out:

1) How the credit applies: the proposed credit is issued as a contra on the first Marketplace invoice and can be amortized across up to two invoices if that makes finance reconciliation easier. We'll need the HubSpot deal id (we have DEAL-2397) to annotate the credit.
2) Usage alignment: to estimate the 25% credit we used the trailing 90-day usage Samir referenced. If you expect a spike tied to the expansion you mentioned on page 3 of your internal brief, let us know so we can model accordingly.

I attached the technical one-pager 'redwood-azure-marketplace-guide.pdf' that the cloud team usually hands to partner procurement — it covers invoice flow, reseller IDs, and expected timeline (7–14 business days for billing activation once legal signs).

Ben Carter
Director, Cloud Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-azure-marketplace-guide.pdf
From: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@acme-corp.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal: Acme - Path to Azure Marketplace Billing with Renewal Incentives

Hi Lauren / Ben —

Thanks for the materials. Procurement is fine with the MAP milestones. Legal asked for two clarifications: 1) the credit mechanics need a short clause suitable for insertion into our MSA amendment (can you provide a 2-3 sentence clause?) and 2) we need a DocuSign-enabled MAP so we can track signoffs across IT, Procurement, and Finance. Also, will the Azure co-sell rep (John) need to countersign anything?

If you can send the legal clause and the DocuSign link by EOD Wednesday, procurement can route for approvals and we can target billing activation by Dec 15 pending signatures.

Best,
Aisha Gomes
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Commerce
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomes <aisha.gomes@acme-corp.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, John Liu <john.liu@microsoft.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Acme - Path to Azure Marketplace Billing with Renewal Incentives

Aisha / Samir —

Attached is the requested 2-sentence legal clause and a DocuSign MAP link: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/Acme-MAP. The clause reads: "Redwood will apply a one-time contra credit equal to 25% of the estimated first-quarter post-migration usage to the initial Marketplace invoice. The credit will be documented in an amendment to the existing MSA and reflected on the invoice(s) as set forth in the mutual action plan."

John — can you confirm if Microsoft needs to countersign the MAP or if a courtesy acknowledgement from the Azure co-sell rep is sufficient?

Next steps we agreed:
- Acme signs MAP via DocuSign by Nov 24.
- Redwood legal will prepare a short MSA amendment template (we'll circulate within 48 hours after MAP signature).
- Billing test (dual-invoice) scheduled for first business week after activation.

If that timeline works, we'll set a firm activation target of Dec 15 and I will open the activation ticket with the marketplace team once MAP is signed.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: marketplace-credit-proposal.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (DocuSign-ready)
